top_signals.title: AI Debt Issuance Defies Rising Yields as SpaceX, Broadcom Plan Major Deals
top_signals.summary: When financing gets more expensive, companies usually slow down their bond sales. Tech companies have instead been ramping up this year, and talk this week of potential big financings from SpaceX and Broadcom Inc. only amplified investor fears about the wave of coming debt.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
